corpora.seed: evals (280 existing development examples; all 14 rules)
corpora.validation: benchmarks/validation (32 development Git cases, isolated grouping)

contrasts.wording vs current: Only question instructions change. Existing policies and composition are retained; explicit task permission for assertions is deferred to a separate policy experiment.
contrasts.json-text vs wording: Named JSON fields replace flat headings; same source facts.
contrasts.json-object vs json-text: Identical JSON fields, native object versus string.
contrasts.criteria vs json-object: Same native state and instructions, additional explicit true/false criteria.

thresholds: unchanged production thresholds; no cutoff selection from these measurements
composition: minimum of all signal scores; not a calibrated violation probability
limitations: Existing synthetic development labels; no independent review or release evidence.
The criteria variant is an added rubric, not just fewer words.
Non-exhaustive search remains insufficient for repository-wide absence claims.
No tool use, reasoning explanation, or additional retrieval is enabled.
analysis: verify state/question hashes for each intended contrast
record resolved model, usage, cost and elapsed time
report regressions and non-evaluated Git cases; do not cherry-pick promotion
